name: start-record-triggered-flow

actions.details: Launch on DML event that meets entry criteria

governor_limits: Runs in transaction; 2 000 executed-element cap per interview

name: start-scheduled-triggered-flow

actions.details: Launch at defined date-time; optional record batch

governor_limits: Batch size 1-200 records; 250 000 interviews/day

name: start-autolaunched-flow

actions.details: Invoked by API, Apex, Subflow, Quick Action

governor_limits: Shares Apex per-tx limits; 50 MB heap

name: get-records

actions.details: Query one or many records into variables

governor_limits: Counts toward 100 SOQL/tx; up to 50 000 rows returned

name: decision

actions.details: Branch logic by evaluating conditions

governor_limits: Each outcome counts toward 2 000 executed-element limit

name: assignment

actions.details: Set or adjust variable values

governor_limits: No special limits; counts as one executed element

name: create-records

actions.details: Insert one or many records

governor_limits: Counts toward 150 DML/tx; all-or-none unless bulkified

name: update-records

actions.details: Modify existing records

governor_limits: Counts toward 150 DML/tx; 10 000 records per DML call

name: delete-records

actions.details: Delete one or many records

governor_limits: Counts toward 150 DML/tx; 10 000 records per DML call

name: loop

actions.details: Iterate through collection items

governor_limits: Max 2 000 iterations per interview

name: collection-sort

actions.details: Order collection and optionally limit items

governor_limits: No extra limits; heavy collections risk hitting element cap

name: collection-filter

actions.details: Return subset of a collection that meets criteria

governor_limits: Element count applies; output collection is new variable

name: subflow

actions.details: Invoke another active flow

governor_limits: Parent and child share transaction and 2 000 element cap

name: pause-wait

actions.details: Suspend interview until date, time, or criteria

governor_limits: Flow must be autolaunched; paused interviews count toward org limit (30 000)

name: screen

actions.details: Collect or display data to user in screen flow

governor_limits: Screen flows run only in Lightning runtime; 50 components per screen

name: quick-action

actions.details: Launch flow via Lightning quick action

governor_limits: Subject to page-layout action limits; flows share runtime limits

name: apex-action

actions.details: Call invocable Apex class

governor_limits: Invocable Apex shares 6M CPU and Apex DML/SOQL caps

name: send-email-action

actions.details: Send and optionally log an email

governor_limits: Email limit: 5 000 single emails/day (Enterprise org default)

name: variable-resource

actions.details: Holds single value or record

governor_limits: Subject to flow memory; 50 MB per interview

name: constant-resource

actions.details: Stores immutable value

governor_limits: No special limits

name: formula-resource

actions.details: Calculates value at runtime

governor_limits: Complex formulas may hit CPU limit; avoid heavy loops

name: text-template-resource

actions.details: Stores rich or plain text with merge fields

governor_limits: Template size ≤32 kB; counts toward interview heap

name: choice-resource

actions.details: Defines selectable option for screen components

governor_limits: Up to 50 choices per component; validated at runtime
